p1: The night Ted Bundy escaped, the guards thought he was asleep in his bed. It was a pile of books.
And it wasn't his first escape.
June 1977. Aspen, Colorado. He was allowed in the courthouse library without shackles.
During a break, he jumped out a second-floor window.
Six days later, police stopped a stolen car. It was him.
Back in jail, he lost weight... and cut a hole in his cell ceiling. One foot wide.
December 30th. He squeezed through... and crawled into a jailer's apartment.
He changed clothes... and walked out the front door.
Nobody noticed until the next afternoon.
About two weeks later, in Florida... he attacked a sorority house.
The real number... has never been confirmed.
